in_marathi.name: Bhanupriya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhanupriya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhanu means 'Moon God' and Priya means 'Beloved'. The name Bhanupriya signifies 'God's Grace' or 'Beloved of God'. It is a revered name in Hindu tradition, symbolizing the divine connection between the individual and the celestial beings.
